svg.title: Huginn pipeline: one fight, compressed
svg.desc: Animated diagram. Game state (health, combat, fire damage) feeds context weights; the learner's preference multiplies them into a utility score; the top items fill three slots. Beats: exploring, combat starts, fire damage raises Resist Fire, critical health triggers an override, repeated Fireball picks are learned, and a slot lock holds a near-tie.

g.text: Out of combat. Context favours utility; nothing is urgent.
In-combat weight (0.3) wakes the damage spells; Candlelight falls away.
Fire damage sets the resist-fire weight to 0.8. The potion jumps to the top.
Health under 35%: the override skips scoring and pins the best restore potion.
Each pick trains Fireball and nudges the passed-over Ice Spike down. Confidence raises λ.
Restore Health edges past Resist Fire (0.38 vs 0.37), but the 3 s lock keeps the slot still.
Each beat is one moment of a ~3.5 minute fight. Every ~100 ms Huginn re-reads game state, re-scores every candidate and refills the slots.
Override bypasses scoring for urgent needs; the slot lock (3 s) stops near-ties from flickering. Values are illustrative, parameters are the shipped defaults.
